verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws. The RSVP CTA is shrunk to pill size and lost among the tag chips, so the action is buried. The large italic subtitle competes with the headline. The 'SOLSTICE' wordmark reads 'SOLST CE', with a background dot breaking it. The legal text is unreadably tiny, and the broken missing-asset placeholder still shows at the bottom right. B edges ahead: its 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' kicker sits directly above the headline, and the date and time are grouped tightly. A strands the kicker up beside the logo and leaves a large gap between 'Saturday 21 June' and the time line.
